title: Isoperimetric theorem (Simon 6.1)
statement: For all m, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≥ 1 there is c = c(m,ℓ) ∈ [0,∞) such that every integer multiplicity T ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^{m+2+ℓ}) with compact support and ∂T = 0 satisfies T = ∂R for some integer multiplicity R ∈ D_{m+2}(ℝ^{m+2+ℓ}) with compact support and M(R)^{(m+1)/(m+2)} ≤ c·M(T).
